content.title: David Spade and Theo Von to Star in Buddy Comedy ‘Busboys’ - IMDb
content.text: David Spade and Theo Von to Star in Buddy Comedy ‘Busboys’David Spade and Theo Von will star in and produce a buddy comedy, “Busboys,” which they wrote and are self-financing.Set in a border town in Arizona, the movie follows David and Theo, two friends who “think becoming waiters will solve all of their problems. They are wrong,” per the logline.Jonah Feingold will direct “Busboys,” which is also produced by Robert Ogden Barnum alongside Spade and Von.Production will kick off Jan. 10 in Los Angeles.“We are looking forward to gracing everyone with this comedy that no one asked for,” said Spade in a statement.Spade, who became a household name during his stint as a “Saturday Night Live” cast member, has also starred in comedies such as “Joe Dirt,” “Grown Ups” and “The Wrong Missy.” He was also in the sitcoms “Rules of Engagement” and “8 Simple Rules.” He received an Emmy nomination for his role as Dennis Finch on “Just Shoot Me.See full article at Variety - Film News11/20/2024by Ethan ShanfeldVariety - Film NewsSimilar NewsNetflixSpider-man: Brand New Day - Could The Upcoming Film Feature This Fan-Favorite Panel From The Comics?4/22/2026ComicBookMovie.comThe 7 Best Docuseries to Binge on Netflix Right Now4/22/2026by Raquel CalhounThe Wrap‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Just Introduced One of the Most Powerful Characters in the MCU4/22/2026by Casey LovingThe WrapSaturday Night LiveNicola Coughlan and Aimee Lou Wood to Host SNL UK’s Return, With Foo Fighters and Meek as Musical Guests4/22/2026by Noah MasireMemorableTV‘Scary Movie 6’ Targets Michael Jackson Child Abuse Allegations With ‘Michael’ Spoof Poster and Tagline: ‘Touching Fans Everywhere’4/22/2026by William EarlVariety Film + TVFocus sets September release for Paul Greengrass’s ‘The Uprising’4/22/2026ScreenDailyDonald TrumpHulk Hogan: Real American Review: Final Words from a Wrestling Giant4/22/2026by Ben CarterGazettelyFCC Media Bureau launches probe into TV ratings system4/22/2026by Matthew KeysThe DeskJudge Rejects Laura Loomer’s Defamation Claim Against Bill Maher & HBO4/22/2026by Ted JohnsonDeadline Film + TVIMDb.com, Inc. takes no responsibility for the content or accuracy of the above news articles, Tweets, or blog posts.
